why: scripts/verify-rcap-verifier-dispositions.mjs requires every verifier script in scripts/ to carry a recorded disposition. Lane D added three, so that verifier is red on this branch and green at the base. The register and package.json are both captain-owned, so the lane reports the exact change instead of making it. This is the only lane-caused regression in the repository's own test chain.
